description: plugins/ralph-overview/tools/overview-mcp/README.md Tool Contracts table (line 71) and the `overview.dev_server.status` section (lines 106-114) do not document the new `consumer-not-initialized` return path that was added in this diff. Per AC11 of plan.md and the v1.1.0 behavioral additions in plugin CLAUDE.md, both `overview.list_tasks` and `overview.dev_server.status` now check `checkConsumerInitialized(context.repoRoot)` before reading the snapshot (see worktree `tools/overview-mcp/src/tools/read-only.ts:45-48` and `dev-server-status.ts:37-40`) and return `{ ok: false, code: 'consumer-not-initialized', suggestedTool: 'overview.init', missing }` instead of the legacy `missing snapshot` error. The README still lists only `missing snapshot` for `overview.list_tasks` and shows no failure shape at all for `overview.dev_server.status`.
suggestedFix: Update the `overview.list_tasks` row's Errors column on line 71 to read `consumer-not-initialized, missing snapshot`. In the `overview.dev_server.status` section starting at line 106, add a bullet documenting the `{ ok: false, code: 'consumer-not-initialized', suggestedTool: 'overview.init', missing: string[] }` return shape when the consumer is not initialized.
